_readme: One template sentence per (kind, outcome), appended when the model's narrative contradicts the server's result, or when a threshold/refusal the model did not preview needs a line of its own. See Astra Dice Plan.md section 5, 'Contradictions between the story and the server result'.

skill.PASS: Whatever the story just said, the attempt actually lands.
skill.FAIL: Whatever the story just said, the attempt actually falls short.

attack.cannot_fire: The weapon is dry. No charge to fire.

hazard.HURT: The hazard actually takes its toll.
hazard.CLEAR: The hazard actually passes without harm.

purchase.refused: There isn't enough in the account for that.
